تستعذون (form X)
# تَسْتَعْذُونَ (tastaʕḏūna) /tas.taʕ.ðuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# تُسْتَعْذَوْنَ (tustaʕḏawna) /tus.taʕ.ðaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
